rows.label: Operating Expenses

rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Income Tax

rows.derivedFormula: Income Tax = Profit Before Tax - Net Profit

note: Income rows filled from the issuer audited annual report in the NGX filing library.
source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from Fidson Healthcare Plc unaudited financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 as reported (newtelegraphng.com, primebusiness.africa and nairametrics.com): Revenue N74.48bn (up 18.9%); cost of sales N42.45bn; gross profit N32.03bn (gross margin 43.01%); operating profit N14.38bn (operating margin 19.31%); Profit before tax N11.70bn; income tax N3.97bn; profit after tax N7.72bn. UNIT: NGN. Cost of Sales and Income Tax are DERIVED (Revenue minus Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Net Profit) so the column ties to the published figures; Revenue and Net Profit are the exact figures already in the file. Net finance costs and Operating Expenses were not published as single lines, so both are left empty rather than approximated. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
